chunks: The Day of Decree/Judgement is their appointed time, all of them.

key_terms.أَجْمَعِينَ: All of them / everyone without exception
key_terms.يَوْمُ الْفَصْلِ: The Day of Decree/Judgement, a specific day of separation and reckoning

ai.seo_question: What is Yawm al-Fasl and why is it the appointed time for all?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ad-Dukhan underscores the inevitability of 'Yawm al-Fasl' as the definitive moment when all disputes are settled and divine justice is fully realized. It highlights that this appointed time is universal, encompassing every individual without exception, serving as the ultimate deadline for accountability before Allah.
